images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Arc 5 supporting-cast MODEL LINEUP, one finished 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG.
Key light: soft neutral studio light from upper left. Flat solid light-grey #E9E9EC everywhere behind the cast; only minimal soft contact shadows beneath the shoes. No scenery, vignette, floor line or frame.
Composition: EXACTLY ONE single horizontal row of the following sixteen Korean adults, one child and one toddler in a stroller, eighteen people total. Everyone fully visible head to feet, front view at one consistent orthographic eye-level camera of 1.6 m, all standing shoes and stroller wheels on ONE common baseline. Fill the available width with the complete lineup, with slight natural space between groups; preserve real human proportions even though the long row makes each figure relatively small. Never make a second row, tier or inset. Each adult is approximately 7 to 7.5 heads tall with legs about half their height; older women may be broad and short but never stubby. Distinct faces, silhouettes, ages and heights. Quiet neutral sheet stances with small changes of weight; hands holding the specified props or clasped. There is NO reference silhouette, scale man, mannequin, height ruler or lettering.
Left to right, every following role must appear once:
1. Branch Chief Yang: 63-year-old thin man, bald crown and grey fringe, round glasses, tired decent lined face; brown cardigan over a grey Association shirt with a small star-and-shield emblem without letters, dark slacks and plain shoes.
2. Tall thin older market auntie, permed grey hair under a dark sun visor, dark teal rubber apron, patterned arm sleeves, rubber boots.
3. Round older market auntie, permed hair under a faded floral headscarf, rust-red rubber apron, arm sleeves and rubber boots.
4. Tiny older market auntie, permed grey hair, one gold necklace, outspoken face, mustard rubber apron, arm sleeves and rubber boots.
5. Old fisherman in his sixties, weathered face with GREY STUBBLE, NAVY KNIT CAP, bright orange waterproof jacket and waterproof trousers, dark rubber boots.
6. Younger fisherman, late twenties, weathered but youthful face, short dark hair, orange waterproof bib trousers over a muted blue work shirt, rubber boots.
7. PC bang owner: sleepy man in his thirties in a grey hoodie and jeans, an UNLIT cigarette behind one ear, holding a plain wooden-handled broom with bristles resting on the baseline.
8. Kanghan PR man in his thirties, smiling, NAVY BLAZER, small SILVER DOUBLE-HEXAGON lapel pin, pale shirt and dark trousers; holding one closed glossy navy presentation folder with a blank cover.
9. Kanghan PR woman in her thirties, smiling, NAVY BLAZER, small SILVER DOUBLE-HEXAGON lapel pin, pale blouse and dark trousers.
10. Their photographer: adult man in practical charcoal clothes, one large black camera visibly held in his hands on an attached neck strap.
11. Middle-aged male tourist, cheerful, a muted sea-blue windbreaker and grey trousers, comfortable plain walking shoes.
12. Middle-aged female tourist, cheerful, a MATCHING sea-blue windbreaker and grey trousers, comfortable plain walking shoes.
13. Evacuee fishmonger father, middle-aged, rubber apron over a practical work shirt, rubber boots; caring ordinary face.
14. Evacuee mother, middle-aged, ordinary covered autumn clothes and plain shoes, hands correctly holding a compact stroller's push handle. Show her whole body alongside the stroller, not hidden behind it.
15. Their TODDLER, plainly dressed, seated safely inside that stroller, visible head and simple clothed body. The stroller stands beside its mother; wheels rest on the same baseline as all feet.
16. Their school-age child, approximately seven, fully clothed in a simple covered jumper, trousers and shoes, standing beside the parents. Draw both children simply, respectfully and without glamour.
17. Kanghan Marine engineer: adult in GREY COVERALLS with a small silver double-hexagon emblem, WHITE HARD HAT, respirator resting around the neck, an ORANGE LIFE VEST worn visibly OVER the coveralls, work boots.
18. Kanghan Marine tactical trooper: tall adult wearing BLACK TACTICAL ARMOUR and a FULL HELMET with a SMOKY VISOR hiding the face, silver double-hexagon emblem on the chest, ORANGE LIFE VEST OVER the armour; small round shield strapped to forearm, shock baton sheathed at hip, a stubby core carbine secured by a visible sling. A simple muted RED STRIPE on the helmet. No glowing weapon.
All devices, folder and camera have blank unlettered surfaces. Repeat the same double-hexagon design for the two PR pins and two crew emblems.
Input image 1 is an APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its crisp ink and opaque cel-shadow treatment. The new image depicts only the supporting cast described above. Do not reproduce the reference character, his orange vest or letter patch. No light effects or supernatural glows on this sheet. The toddler is the only person sitting. Count carefully: sixteen adults plus the standing child plus the seated toddler, eighteen people, one row.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
problems: Yang has a Kanghan-like badge instead of Association star-and-shield; extra marks on hoodie and tourist jackets.
Some textile mottling and short older-woman proportions.
